title: Warnings for This Year
body:
(Mawlana Shaykh stands) Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, la ilaaha illa-Llah, Allahu Akbar, Allahu
Akbar, wa lillahi 'l-hamd! Thumma salaatu was-salaam, alfu salaat, alfu salaam `alaa Sayyidi 'l-Awwaleen wa
’l-akhireen, habeebi Rabbi 'l-`Alameen, Sayyidina Muhammadan wa `alaa aalihi wa sahbihi ajma`een wa
man tabi`ahum bi ihsaan ila Yawm ad-Deen. Yaa Rabb. Allah! A`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani 'r-rajeem.
Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem. (Mawlana Shaykh sits)
As-salaamu `alaykum, `ibaadAllah. `IbaadAllah, salaamullah `alayna wa `alaykum. As-salamu `alayna wa
`alaa man `it-taba 'l-huda. Yaa Rabbee! SubhaanAllah, alhamdulillah wa laa ilaaha illa-Llah, Allahu Akbar
wa la hawla wa la quwatta illa billahi 'l-`Aliyyu 'l-`Azheem.
O People! Our Attenders! Everyone who is in this world, throughout the east and west, from north to south,
all of you must be attenders, because we are here addressing all of Mankind.
O People! You can't imagine the power of Heavens! Your power is like dust. Now people are so proud with
their technology. (Mawlana Shaykh laughs) When this weather is coming like this and covering them, they
are going to be just like dust on this world. They were so proud and saying now there is a hurricane, and
before that, it was snowing for one week and everything on Earth was going to be down. I am asking, why are

you not defending yourself against rain or snow? All of you are running into your homes to protect
yourselves. Why? If the Lord of Heavens sends one more power with the snow, in one or two days, or even in
one hour, all European, American, Chinese, eastern people and western people would be under it, not
breathing, and they would die!
Utanmazlar! Shameless ones! (They say,) "We are going to send what they are sending." What are you
sending? They are asking to send their missiles from North Korea to South Korea. Why are you not sending
your missiles up to take away this weather? A little more and they won't be able to breathe. What
shamelessness, to go against Allah! They are so brave when the sun is shining, when there are no storms,
when there is no snow, when no oceans are moving, and when there are no hurricanes. They are so proud!
Why are you now not using your bravery? Why? You traitors, slaves of Shaytan! Shaytan is blowing on them
to make them claim, "We are so powerful!" Where is your power now? They are sleeping in airports and after
awhile, when nothing is coming on them, they are going to die in airports.
O People! O Mankind, from east to west! You must think about this holy month that you are not accepting.
Even our heedless Muslims are not giving enough honor for the holy month, Muharram al-Haram, trying to
make the heedless Muslim world drink and dance with Christians and unbelievers. Pttuh `alayhum, spit on
them! Cursing is coming from Heavens on those shameless ones! Where is your power? Show it! Thousands
of people are imprisoned in airports and can't move, but still ask to make a festival for this night which has no
meaning. It is not a holy night or a holy day. If it were a holy day or holy night, they must pray, glorifying
Allah Almighty. But tonight the whole world's people are showing they belong to the shaytanic world, under
Shaytan's control, worshiping Shaytan. If it is a holy night, why are you going to be Shaytan's slaves? I am
asking from the Lord of Heavens that this night be the last New Year. O Lord of Heavens! Make it the last
one, so people living on Earth do not make another foolish and dirty night such as this!
Where are the holy people? They are looking and not saying anything about this foolishness! Where are the
Al-Azhar `ulamas, Sham `ulamas, Baghdad `ulamas, Hijaaz `ulamas? Why aren't they fighting this? They
give the excuse, "O Shaykh, they are going to play tonight." Spit on them! Spit twice on the Muslim world! I
am speaking with firmness!
Tawbah, yaa Rabbee. Tawbah, yaa Rabbee. Tawbah, yaa Rabbee. For that reason the Seal of Prophets,

Sayyidina Muhammad (s), (Mawlana Shaykh stands and sits) asked from the Lord of Heavens:
Allahumma laa takilnee ilaa anfusina tarfata `ayn.
O Allah! Don't leave me to myself for the blink of an eye.
The Seal of Prophets (s) asked from the Lord of Heavens not to allow us to be slaves to our egos, because our
egos belong to Shaytan! Tawbah, yaa Rabbee. Tawbah, yaa Rabbee. Tawbah, astaghfirullah. Tawbah, yaa
Rabbee. Tawbah, yaa Rabbee. Tawbah, astaghfirullah.Forgive us, our Lord!
(They say,) "Happy New Year! Happy New Year!" How do you say it in Arabic? "`Eid milaad sa`eed."
Christians, mashaa-Allah, are putting up so many lights, everywhere. O our Lord, laa tu'aakhidhna, "Don't
condemn us (for what they do)!" O Lord of Heavens! Don't leave us to reach another such foolish night and
such a foolish celebration, which is not acceptable in real religions. That is a shaytanic way (to celebrate New
Year's Eve, 1 January.) Shaytan is asking to show them, "I am commanding all these nations to follow my
orders." Like a munkar, evil one, they are never acceptable.
They will say, "Shaykh Effendi, we had lots of fun this evening. We also ate turkey." May they eat poison!
Tomorrow they are going to say, "Ohh, my stomach! Ohh, my head!" After that, hospitals won't be able to
treat them. If you are making 100 hospitals in every city, it is still not enough to look after people because the
doctors will be drunk and patients will come to those who are drunk.
They are saying, "O my doctor! Something is happening to my head. I am using so many tablets, but nothing
is happening for me."
The doctor is also drunk, saying, "I am also like you. Since midnight I've been taking a handful of tablets. I
never saw my stomach giving me so much pain. Where is it coming from?"
From Jahannam, Hell! I am thinking that this is the final mukafaat, reward for New Year's enjoyments, up to
the second year, never ending. It's beginning tomorrow, because everything they are eating and drinking
tonight is for the honor of Shaytan. And the Lord of Heavens is punishing them, saying, "You are never going
to be healthy until you say, (Mawlana Shaykh stands) 'La ilaaha illa-Llah Muhammadun
Rasoolullah!'" (Mawlana Shaykh sits)

O People! Leave the wrong way, or something will be sent on you. It will not be sent from Heavens as
revenge, but it will be sent from someone to someone else. You can imagine what it will be: Armageddon, the
greatest war. And what is reaching to our holy ones is through that Armageddon; four from every five are
going to die, and only one will remain. If there are five billion inhabitants of dunya, four billion are going to
die, leaving one billion. May Allah forgive us!
O People! Think on it. Wa msa `alayna illa 'l-balsaghu 'l-mubeen. We are only a weak servant to say this.
Leave Shaytan and come to your Lord. Make sajdah to Him and say, "O, our Lord! We are Your servants!
Arhamnaa, give Your blessings and `afuw, forgive us!"
O People! Don't make a shaytanic celebration tonight that makes your Creator, the Lord of Heavens, angry
with you! This year shall be a terrible year. May our Lord forgive us. Run to Allah to be protected. May Allah
forgive us for the honor of His most beloved servant, Sayyidina Muhammad (s)! (Mawlana Shaykh stands
and sits)
Fatihah.
(Baya``)
